_doc: Hardware / scene settings. Wall coordinates: cm, X right, Y up as seen from the camera.

camera._index: auto = first camera 0..4 whose image contains this scene's board; or a number

_up_hint: auto | up | right | down | left : image direction that is physically UP. auto = from the track shape (theme 2) or floor colour + a short climb after take-off (theme 1).

closed_path._start: start point: direction from the track centre (deg, 0 = right, -90 = bottom). circle: bottom-right as on the course sheet; square: middle of the bottom edge (clean step before the first corner)

theme2._land: land_trigger: zone = land as soon as the drone is over the lower blue square (C); laser_off = land when the operator switches the laser off (0.7 s without dot, after it was used); key = only by pressing L. The black obstacle is never used in flight.
